fieldMarks: White wing patch, obvious in flight but often hidden on the water.
Drake black with a small white teardrop around the eye.
Hens and immature males very dark with paler facial patches.
behavior: Flocks fly low in wavering lines over water.
Generally silent; soft whistles and guttural croaks.
Dives for mollusks, crustaceans, aquatic insects and some fish.
Males winter farther north than females and young.
habitat: Breeds on lakes, ponds and slow rivers in open country; winters on coastal salt bays and ocean shallows, especially over shellfish beds.
range: Breeds across Alaska and Canada; winters on both coasts and the Great Lakes, with inland occurrences on large waters.

lookalikes.name: Surf scoter
lookalikes.howToTell: Hens are told apart by differing face and eye pattern; white-winged shows the white wing patch.
